verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents its own bulk capability: users can "add, view, and bulk update employee data." It also files unlimited 1099s and automatically sends copies to contractors. These are single marketing-level mentions, with no detail on scope, limits, or programmatic batch operations. missing for 10: documentation of which fields and objects support bulk updates, bulk actions across other item types (deductions, timesheets, compensation changes), API-level batch endpoints for automated or AI-driven use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Manage employee information, including profiles, team directories, and add, view, and bulk update employee data.
Create and e-file unlimited 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC form with the IRS** We’ll automatically send copies to your contractors.
